summary: GRAVEYARD expectations/execution pass covers every b03 company while keeping Earth Score separate from market expectations. Primary evidence supports execution treatment for TER, AUR, PWR, CEG and SMR. Live normalized price/consensus is not fabricated and its absence is not itself a baseline blocker.

materialFindings.finding: Execution evidence is mixed but reproducible: 2025 revenue rose 15.9% in products on AI compute/system-test demand while Robotics revenue fell 15.5%; Q2 2026 provides a fresh segment operating anchor. Expectation risk should include customer/geographic concentration rather than extrapolating AI demand linearly.
Fresh execution anchor not acquired; normalized market expectations remain unknown and non-gating.

Demand exposure is credible, but execution treatment must account for fixed-price/EPC margin risk, subcontractor dependence and customer concentration. Backlog should not be treated as guaranteed margin or cash flow.

CEG asset-duration execution is underway but regulatory approval is not complete.
SMR certification progress and commercial execution are separate states.
unknowns: Normalized live price, consensus and crowding are not established as canonical T0 inputs in this pass and remain unknown.

peerRequests: Deep Runner: obtain current issuer results/filings for seven under-acquired names, prioritizing backlog/customer/financing conversion fields.
